Q5738.reason: Under the predominant-purpose test the UCC governs only if the goods were the predominant reason for the deal, and Connie's main aim was the laptop, so she likely wins; this is a revision from my earlier C, which implied the UCC applies by default even when neither part predominates.

Q5278.reason: Burglary requires an unlawful entry with intent to commit a felony at the time of entry, and the defendant entered the open party intending only to have fun, so the later theft does not make the entry burglarious.

Q8324.reason: Agitation and urgent drug-seeking suggest withdrawal or craving, which fits reduced dopamine release into the synaptic cleft.
